title: The Mourner's Debt
location: Crystalline Desert Depths — the crystal-cave approach
summary: An injured Salvari near a hidden cave mouth needs help the desert won't give freely. A Reptilian patrol hunts the approach, and something older is watching the bargain.

objectives.text: Cross the desert depths toward the singing-crystal cave mouth.
Drive off the Reptilian patrol before it reaches the wounded Salvari.

args.text: Two Reptilian Troopers and a Grey spotter. The Salvari can't run.

objectives.text: Help the wounded Salvari. They keep trying to give you something instead of taking help.
A third party arrives — a lone Mantis Arbiter, drawn by the suspicion you carry. Hear its terms, or refuse them.
Escort the Salvari down toward their camp.
The cave mouth is held. A Saurian Warlord bars the only way down.

args.text: The Warlord won't let refugees pass. Neither will it let you.

objectives.text: The way down is open. The Salvari will tell their camp who opened it.
The Salvari is gone. The desert keeps its debts either way.

_hooks: Wraps act2-desert's L10 content into a quest: the injured-Salvari side-quest hook, the Reptilian-Trooper+Grey-Tasked patrol (grey-patrol branch), the Saurian Warlord gated arena (warlord branch), and the Mantis Arbiter wildcard (mantis-ambush branch, gated by mole.suspected so it ONLY appears for a player carrying the Carrier-arc suspicion — making the ambush feel earned, per STORYLINE_EXPANSIONS (c)). Sets warlord.dead/spared and salvari.allied which act2_refugee_haven (L11) reads. First on-screen K'thara line fires here.
_voice: The Salvari grammar of grief: they try to GIVE before they receive (the mourner's debt). Warlord can be spared (mercy line) — the canon spare-or-kill choice carried into Act 2.
